title: For password-based authentication, AAA Services must be configured to update the list of passwords on an organization-defined frequency.
components: UDS Core 1.14 shared Keycloak realm and Horizon OIDC clients; no bundled application Keycloak
justification: Shared UDS policy contains no maintained compromised/common-password blacklist validator or update integration. Length/classes/history are not the required corpus check. This belongs at sharedidentity, not the API. Native Keycloak already supplies password-denylist validation and reload. The source-known residual is Gallatin corpus delivery/policy/update configuration, not an unimplemented product capability.
next_step: Gallatin mounts its approved maintained denylist at /opt/keycloak/data/password-blacklists, appends passwordBlacklist(filename) to the existing Core realmInitEnv.PASSWORD_POLICY without dropping current FIPS KDF/length/classes/history/expiry, and updates the live realm password policy if already imported. Configure Gallatin-owned corpus cadence/incident updates; Keycloak natively reloads changed files (default60s), so no new API or custom validator service is needed.

components: UDS Core 1.14 shared Keycloak realm and Horizon OIDC clients; no bundled application Keycloak
justification: Actual UDS supports an explicit CRL file/cache path, but x509-cert-auth.crl-checking-enabled defaultsfalse and CRLdistribution-point checkingfalse. OCSP defaults enabled/failclosed, satisfying online revocation but not this distinct local-cache requirement. Configure cache or document approved offline/revocation tailoring at IdP. The cache implementation and delivery recipe already exist in Core; the shipped checking flag is off and Gallatin owns mounting/enabling/refreshing it.
next_step: Gallatin uses Core CRL packaging/mount support, sets realmInitEnv.X509_CRL_CHECKING_ENABLED="true", X509_CRL_ABORT_IF_NON_UPDATED="true" and X509_CRL_RELATIVE_PATH to mounted approved files, and updates the existing dod-cac authenticator where necessary. Refresh the CRL data image/volume before expiry. Keep OCSP fail-closed; disable OCSP only for an approved disconnected CRL alternative. No custom Keycloak cache or API code.
